svg.title: Move trusted artifacts through explicit approval gates
svg.desc: Diagram of a six-step artifact pipeline crossing a controlled boundary. On a connected acquisition station, acquire authentic publisher artifacts and all dependencies, verify provenance and signatures against an independently trusted manifest, then authorize transfer. Inside the isolated environment, quarantine transferred artifacts, recheck hashes and scan for malware. A hash match demonstrates integrity, not authenticity. Approve promotion and import, then consume approved local catalogs and registries only. Any failure remains quarantined. The boundary is not automated internet synchronization.
svg.text: Move trusted artifacts through explicit approval gates
Read down the connected lane (1-3), then down the isolated lane (4-6).
Reject or investigate; never promote, import or consume failed artifacts.
The dashed boundary is controlled transfer, not automated internet synchronization.
